# Global Orators Project (GOP) — Full Documentation & Index

## Overview
Global Orators is an African-rooted speech, debate, and executive communication platform. It bridges high-stakes intellectual rigor with profound emotional sovereignty.

## Branch Architectures

### 1. Academy Track (Competitive Debate & Forensics)
- Formats: British Parliamentary (BP), World Universities Debating Championship (WUDC), World Schools Debating Championship (WSDC).
- Core Disciplines: Extension construction, burden-of-proof allocation, normative weighing, whip rebuttal mastery, dynamic POI (Points of Information) handling.
- Target Metric: 135-145 WPM vocal cadence with razor-sharp argumentative structure.

### 2. Foundation Track (Catharsis & Vocal Escapism)
- Philosophy: Speaking as healing, reclaiming voice from patriarchal and colonial silence, authentic personal expression.
- Core Disciplines: Breath support, diaphragmatic resonance, trauma-informed storytelling, emotional openness calibration.
- Rehearsals: Private Catharsis Vault for expressive audio reflections.

### 3. Executive Track (High-Stakes Boardroom & Keynote Oratory)
- Philosophy: Sovereign executive presence, high-conviction decision-making, investor narrative structuring.
- Core Disciplines: Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) discipline, risk-adjusted defense, stakeholder alignment.
- Rehearsals: Boardroom pitch simulation, executive pacing, concise delivery.

## Technical Architecture
- Frontend: Single Page Application with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite.
- Backend: High-performance Python FastAPI service with SQLAlchemy async, SQLite/PostgreSQL, and WebSockets.
- Security: Role-based authorization, PBKDF2 password hashing, strict multi-coach isolation, server-authoritative habit tracking, sanitized inputs.
